Key accounts, channels and new business · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Channel conflict triage

Mauricio · Channel Operations Analyst

Thirty-eight distributors with territories by state and by segment sell a manufacturer's equipment, and the manufacturer receives 25 to 40 opportunity registrations a week.

When it runs
Every Monday and Thursday, when the channel manager exports the opportunity registrations pending approval from the portal and sends them to the employee
What it delivers in production
One opinion per registration, minutes after the export, classified CLEAR, CONFLICT or QUESTION, with the distributor that has precedence, the clause or rule applied and the suggested reply for the portal.
Who decides
Issues an opinion; the channel manager decides
Effort
Calibrate on 40 decided registrations; 2 weeks reading everything
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

    empty
  • where it writes the result

# Tiebreak and registration rule (channel manager)

## Registration validity
- An approved registration is valid while there is activity. With no activity for more than 90 calendar days (counted from last_activity to today), it is expired and gives precedence to no one.
- A denied registration never gives precedence.
- CLEAR gets the reply "approve, valid until" the registration date plus 90 calendar days.

## Same client
- Same client is the same CNPJ (company tax ID) or the same root (first 8 digits). Head office and branches count together, including for the direct sales list.

## Precedence
1. Account reserved for direct sales: UNCLEAR, the manager decides.
2. A territory clause by segment with exclusivity beats the state in another contract.
3. The first valid registration (approved and not expired) prevails.
4. Policy silent or conflicting clauses between two contracts: UNCLEAR.

## Reply to the distributor
- CLEAR: "approve, valid until Mon D, YYYY".
- CONFLICT: "deny: there is already an active registration or reserved territory for this client". Never the other distributor's name, nor the value of the other opportunity.
- UNCLEAR: "await the channel manager's decision".

## Rules with no leeway
- Client CNPJ only masked, in any part of the output (line, justification, summary): **.***.***/0001-**, with only the 4 branch digits. E.g.: 5103 appears as **.***.***/0002-**.
- An id repeated in the export produces a single opinion. E.g.: 5101 comes twice and has one line.
- UNCLEAR beats the other reasons: value above R$ 2 million, empty value or root in direct sales. E.g.: 5105 (R$ 2.4 million), 5108 (empty value) and 5103 (root in direct sales).
- Expired does not count: today minus last_activity above 90 days. E.g.: 3990 had activity on Aug 1, 2026, 107 days before Nov 16, 2026, expired; 4402 from Center Distributor is active and has precedence over 5104.
- Exclusive segment beats state. E.g.: 5106 from Serra Distributor in RS, metalworking, is CONFLICT under clause 3.1 of South Distributor.
- The internal justification may cite the distributor with precedence; the suggested reply never does. E.g.: 5102 cites registration 4198 from Paulista Distributor only in the justification.
- Expired still counts for the value flag. E.g.: 5107 (R$ 150 thousand) against 3720 (R$ 420 thousand, expired): half R$ 210 thousand, CLEAR with VALUE BELOW HALF. 5104 (R$ 210 thousand) against 4402 (R$ 230 thousand): half R$ 115 thousand, no flag.
- The root is also CNPJ and never appears in digits. E.g.: 5102 cites "registration 4198 from Paulista Distributor, same root, active"; 5103 says only "root in direct sales".
- The final answer, the run report and the STATE are outputs too: what a rule says to omit does not appear in them, not even to explain the exclusion.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI does not decide in the portal and does not write to the distributor: it prepares the opinion and the reply, which the channel manager sends, because denying a registration is a contractual act and can be contested. The reply to a denied registration never reveals which distributor has precedence or the value of the other opportunity. The end customer's CNPJ appears masked in the opinion. An account reserved for direct sales, a value above R$ 2 million or contracts with conflicting clauses always come out as QUESTION.

Common mistakes

  • Treating headquarters and branch as the same customer, or as different customers, when the policy does not say so.
  • Giving precedence to the oldest registration without checking whether it expired for lack of activity.
  • Deciding by the city's state when the contract defines territory by segment.
  • Revealing to the losing distributor who won the registration.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Channel manager time per conflictfrom 30 to 50 minutes to 5 to 10 minutes reading the opinionestimate based on the described routine
Registrations answered to the distributor within 2 business daysfrom not measured to above 90%estimate based on the described routine
Match between the opinion and the historical decision during calibration90% or more, with no false conflict, the acceptance criterionestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Opinions for the 2026-09-03 export, 31 registrations.

Reg. 4410 | Distributor North | customer CNPJ (company tax ID) **.***.***/0001-** | Belém/PA | food segment | est. value R$ 380 thousand | CLEAR | distributor's state and segment, no previous registration | reply: approve, valid until 2026-12-02

Reg. 4412 | Distributor Highlands | customer CNPJ **.***.***/0001-** | Caxias do Sul/RS | metalworking segment | est. value R$ 1.1 million | CONFLICT | registration 4198 by Distributor South for the same CNPJ on 2026-07-21, active (visit logged on 08/28) | precedence: Distributor South, first valid registration rule | reply: deny and state that an active registration exists, without naming the distributor

Reg. 4415 | Distributor Capital | customer CNPJ **.***.***/0002-** | Campinas/SP | pharmaceutical segment | est. value R$ 640 thousand | QUESTION | CNPJ is a branch of an account reserved for direct sales (headquarters on the exceptions list); the policy does not say whether the reservation covers branches | needs the channel manager's decision

Reg. 4419 | Distributor West | Cuiabá/MT | agribusiness segment | R$ 210 thousand | CONFLICT | registration 3990 by the same distributor expired on 08/15 (no activity for 90 days) and new registration 4402 by Distributor Center on 09/01 | precedence: Distributor Center | reply: deny

SUMMARY: 24 CLEAR, 5 CONFLICT, 2 QUESTION. Estimated manager reading load: 7 opinions.
